body.name: Armwise empirical quantile lift
body.construction: For each arm, form \(\widehat F_a=n_a^{-1}\sum_{i:Z_i=a}\delta_{x_{ai}}\) and \(G_a=N^{-1}\sum_{j=1}^N\delta_{Q_{\widehat F_a}((j-1/2)/N)}\); evaluate \(L_N(G)\), \(U_{\mathrm{lo}}(G)\), and \(U_{\mathrm{hi}}(G)\) by the fractional program and \(\mathsf A_{\mathrm{round}}\).
